description: Weekly USDA crop progress + condition by crop and state. For CONDITION queries ("what % of corn is good or excellent", "crop condition this week") the response includes a condition_summary with the latest national week's ratings AND the standard combined good_or_excellent_pct. For PROGRESS use stat_category="PROGRESS" (planted/emerged/harvested %). Pass stat_category to narrow (otherwise both are returned).

stat_category.description: Narrow to "CONDITION" (good/excellent ratings) or "PROGRESS" (planting/harvest %). Optional — omit for both.

year.description: Year, e.g., "2026". Optional — defaults to current year.

name: nass_crop_progress
